title: 喜德盛RS7，10000公里体验报告
notes: Owner report published 2025-08-13 about a 2024 China-market XDS RS7 with Shimano 105 electronic shifting, bought in June 2024 and ridden more than 10,000 km without a dropped chain or shifting fault on that bike. The owner replaced the original Novatec R5 wheels and fitted 28C tubeless tires. Whether this 2024 RS7 shares the current X-LAB RS7 frame is not established; it is historical owner context, not a current specification.
